svg.title: Plan: the grp8 strip in seven segments
svg.desc: The eight plugins of grp8 in signal order: comp, drive, delay, drive, comp, comp, drive, delay. Each drive is pinned isolated and gets a red worker of its own. The two comps next to each other share a worker as the chain chain:1.4. Every other plugin has no neighbour to share with and gets a teal worker of its own.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: plan 1 0 1 2 3 4 5 6 7, grouping on, every drive pinned isolated
